jobs_experience_range.name: jobs_experience_range
jobs_experience_range.value: ("jobs"."experience_min" IS NULL OR "jobs"."experience_min" BETWEEN 0 AND 50) AND ("jobs"."experience_max" IS NULL OR "jobs"."experience_max" BETWEEN 0 AND 50) AND ("jobs"."experience_min" IS NULL OR "jobs"."experience_max" IS NULL OR "jobs"."experience_min" <= "jobs"."experience_max")

jobs_salary_range.name: jobs_salary_range
jobs_salary_range.value: ("jobs"."salary_min_minor" IS NULL OR "jobs"."salary_min_minor" >= 0) AND ("jobs"."salary_max_minor" IS NULL OR "jobs"."salary_max_minor" >= 0) AND ("jobs"."salary_min_minor" IS NULL OR "jobs"."salary_max_minor" IS NULL OR "jobs"."salary_min_minor" <= "jobs"."salary_max_minor")

invitations_years_order.name: invitations_years_order
invitations_years_order.value: "invitations"."start_year" IS NULL OR "invitations"."batch_year" IS NULL OR "invitations"."start_year" <= "invitations"."batch_year"
